Title: Fresh install shows splash then the Welcome screen
Preconditions: Fresh install (or app data cleared); device online; backend reachable.
Steps:
1. Launch the app.
2. Watch the splash screen until it navigates.
Expected: Splash shows logo, animated 'Bananatalk' title, tagline 'Learn · Chat · Meet' and three pulsing dots for at least ~1.4 s, then fades to the Welcome screen: 'MEET  ·  CHAT  ·  CONNECT', 'Make global friends on Bananatalk', 'Join millions of language learners today' and buttons 'Continue with Apple' (iOS only), 'Continue with Google', 'Continue with Email'. No pop-ups, no crash.

Title: Valid saved session restores straight into the app
Preconditions: Completed email/password account A (profile + terms done). Logged in on the device.
Steps:
1. Force-kill the app.
2. Launch it again.
Expected: Splash, then the main tab shell (/home) opens directly. No Welcome/Login screen, no Terms screen, no 'Session expired' message. Chats load and the socket is live (send yourself a message from another device: it arrives in real time).

Title: Expired access token is refreshed silently on cold start; offline keeps the session
Preconditions: Completed email/password account A (profile + terms done). Logged in. Local/staging backend with JWT_EXPIRE set short (e.g. 2m) so the access token expires; refresh token still valid.
Steps:
1. Log in, then force-kill the app.
2. Wait until the access token has expired (>2 min).
3. Launch the app online.
4. Force-kill again, enable airplane mode, launch again.
Expected: Step 3: lands in the app (refresh-token exchange happens silently, no login screen, no snackbar). Step 4 (offline): still lands in the app shell, NOT logged out; screens show their offline/empty states and recover once the network returns.

Title: Revoked session on cold start lands on the Welcome screen
Preconditions: Completed email/password account A (profile + terms done). Logged in on device 1 (biometric login NOT enabled). A second device or Postman available.
Steps:
1. Force-kill the app on device 1.
2. On device 2, reset account A's password via 'Forgot Password?' (this revokes all refresh tokens).
3. Launch the app on device 1.
Expected: Device 1 shows splash then the Welcome screen (signed out). No crash, no loop back into the app. Logging in with the NEW password works.

Title: Apple sign-in button is iOS-only
Preconditions: Fresh install (or app data cleared); device online; backend reachable.
Steps:
1. On Android open the Welcome screen.
2. Tap 'Continue with Email' to open the Login screen and look at the social row.
3. Repeat both on iOS.
Expected: Android: no Apple button on Welcome or Login (only Google, plus the fingerprint chip if biometric is enabled). iOS: 'Continue with Apple' above 'Continue with Google' on Welcome; Apple then Google icons on Login.

Title: Email entry validates empty and malformed addresses
Preconditions: Fresh install (or app data cleared); device online; backend reachable.
Steps:
1. Welcome → 'Continue with Email' → tap 'Register' at the bottom of the Login screen.
2. On 'Create Account' tap the send button with the email field empty.
3. Enter 'abc@def' and tap send.
Expected: Screen titled 'Sign Up' with 'Create Account' / 'Enter your email to get started'. Empty: snackbar 'Please enter your email address'. 'abc@def': 'Please enter a valid email address'. No request is sent, no navigation.

Title: Already-registered email cannot start a new signup
Preconditions: Completed email/password account A (profile + terms done).
Steps:
1. Open Register (Welcome → Continue with Email → Register).
2. Enter account A's email and send.
Expected: Error snackbar 'A user with this email already exists. Please login instead.' Stays on the email screen; no code email is sent.

Title: Verification code is sent and the Verify Email screen opens
Preconditions: Fresh install (or app data cleared); device online; backend reachable. An email address you can read that has never been registered.
Steps:
1. Open Register and enter the new email.
2. Tap send.
3. Check the mailbox (and spam).
Expected: Snackbar 'Verification code sent to your email!'; 'Verify Email' screen opens with 'Verify Your Email', 'We sent a 6-digit code to' + the email, six digit boxes and 'Resend (60s)' counting down. Email arrives with a 6-digit code, stated valid for 15 minutes.

Title: Correct code verifies the email and opens Step 1 of 2
Preconditions: On the Verify Email screen with a fresh code.
Steps: 1. Type the 6 digits from the email.
Expected: Verification fires automatically when the 6th digit is entered: success animation, snackbar 'Email verified successfully!', then 'Create Your Account' screen with 'Step 1 of 2', 'Basic info to get you started' and the email shown read-only under 'Email (Verified)'. Back does not return to the code screen (it was replaced).

Title: Wrong verification code shakes and clears
Preconditions: On the Verify Email screen with a fresh code.
Steps: 1. Enter 6 wrong digits (e.g. 000000).
Expected: Digit boxes shake and clear; snackbar 'That code is not correct. Check the code and try again.' User can type again.

Title: Five wrong codes or an expired code invalidates it and unlocks Resend
Preconditions: On the Verify Email screen with a fresh code.
Steps:
1. Enter a wrong code 5 times.
2. Now enter the correct code from the email.
3. Separately: request a code, wait more than 15 minutes, enter it.
Expected: 5th wrong attempt: 'Too many incorrect attempts. Request a new code.'; the Resend button becomes active immediately (countdown jumps to 0, button pulses). The old correct code no longer works. Expired code: 'That code has expired. Request a new one.' and Resend active immediately. A newly requested code works.

Title: Resend countdown and resend replaces the old code
Preconditions: On the Verify Email screen right after sending.
Steps:
1. Try to tap Resend while it shows 'Resend (NNs)'.
2. Wait for 60 s, tap 'Resend'.
3. Enter the FIRST code.
Expected: Resend is disabled during 'Resend (60s)'…'Resend (1s)'. After 60 s it reads 'Resend'; tapping shows 'Verification code resent!' and the countdown restarts at 60. The first code is now rejected ('That code is not correct…'); the second code works.

Title: Hourly email limit is enforced
Preconditions: Same network/IP for all attempts.
Steps: 1. Request verification or password-reset codes 16 times within one hour (any addresses).
Expected: Requests 1–15 succeed. The 16th shows 'Too many email requests, please try again after 1 hour.' (Forgot Password shows the 'Slow down a moment' panel instead).

Title: Required-field validation on Create Your Account
Preconditions: Reached 'Create Your Account' after verifying a new email.
Steps: 1. Leave everything empty and tap 'Next'.
Expected: Inline errors: 'Please enter your name', 'Please enter a password', 'Please select your gender', 'Please select your birth date'. Stays on the screen.

Title: Password rules and confirm-password match
Preconditions: On 'Create Your Account', other fields valid.
Steps:
1. Enter password 'Abc1234' (7 chars), tap Next.
2. Try 'abcdefg1', then 'ABCDEFG1', then 'Abcdefgh'.
3. Enter 'Abcdefg1' with confirm 'Abcdefg2'.
4. Enter 'Abcdefg1' in both.
Expected: Errors in order: 'Password must be at least 8 characters long', '...at least one uppercase letter', '...at least one lowercase letter', '...at least one number', then 'Passwords do not match'. Strength meter under the field moves through Weak / Good / Strong. Valid matching password passes.

Title: Users under 18 are blocked
Preconditions: On 'Create Your Account'.
Steps:
1. Tap 'Select your birth date' and pick a date 17 years ago.
2. Fill the rest validly, tap Next.
3. Change the date to 19 years ago, tap Next.
Expected: 17 years: 'You must be at least 18 years old', no navigation. 19 years: proceeds to the profile wizard.

Title: Optional username live availability check
Preconditions: On 'Create Your Account'. Know an existing username.
Steps:
1. Type 'ab' in 'Username (optional)'.
2. Type an existing username.
3. Type a new unused one, e.g. 'qa_user_123'.
4. Clear the field and complete the step.
Expected: 'ab' → '3–20 characters, letters, numbers, or underscore' and Next is blocked while it's shown. Existing → 'Already taken' (reserved words → 'Not available'). Unused → 'Available'. Empty username is allowed.

Title: Resume banner restores step-1 fields after the app was closed
Preconditions: Fresh registration in progress on 'Create Your Account'.
Steps:
1. Enter name, choose gender and birth date (and a password).
2. Force-kill the app within the same day.
3. Start registration again (same or another email), verify the code.
4. Tap 'Continue' on the banner. Repeat and tap 'Start Over' instead.
Expected: Banner 'Continue where you left off?' with 'Start Over' / 'Continue'. Continue fills name, gender and birth date; password is NOT restored. Start Over hides the banner and clears saved progress. Progress older than 7 days is not offered.

Title: Email signup wizard: Photo step requires a photo
Preconditions: Completed Step 1 of 2 for a new email account.
Steps:
1. Look at the progress bar labels.
2. On 'Add a profile photo' try 'Next' without a photo.
3. Tap the avatar, choose a photo from the gallery (or camera).
Expected: Progress segments read 'Photo', 'Languages', 'Finish' (no 'About you' – gender/birthday already given). 'Next' is disabled until a photo is picked; after picking, the photo shows with an edit badge and 'Next' advances to Languages.

Title: Languages step validation, same-language guard and Swap
Preconditions: On the 'Your languages' step.
Steps:
1. Tap Next with nothing chosen.
2. Pick native only, Next. Pick learning only, Next.
3. Pick English for both 'I speak' and 'I'm learning'.
4. Pick Korean / English, choose a level, tap 'Swap'.
Expected: Messages in order: 'Please select your native language', 'Please select the language you're learning', 'Please select your current level'. Same language: 'Learning language cannot be the same as native language' (or 'Native language cannot be the same as learning language') and the duplicate is not kept. Swap exchanges the two languages. With both + level, Next goes to Finish.

Title: Terms checkbox is required on Finish; link opens the Terms screen
Preconditions: On the Finish step ('Almost done!').
Steps:
1. Tap 'Start Learning!' with the terms box unticked.
2. Tap the 'Terms of Service' link in 'I agree to the Terms of Service'.
3. Scroll, tick 'I agree to the Terms of Service and Zero Tolerance Policy', tap 'Accept and Continue'.
Expected: Unticked: 'Please accept the Terms of Service'. Link opens the Terms of Service screen (sections incl. 'Zero Tolerance Policy', 'End User License Agreement (EULA)'). Accepting returns to Finish with the checkbox ticked.

Title: Location is optional; denying permission does not block signup
Preconditions: On Finish step; location permission never granted.
Steps:
1. Tap 'Tap to detect location' and DENY the OS permission.
2. Optionally enter City/Country manually, then clear it.
3. Tick terms and tap 'Start Learning!'.
Expected: Denial shows 'Failed to get location' (no crash, no dead end). Registration completes without a location. NOTE: helper text currently reads 'Required — helps match you with partners nearby' although location is optional – log as copy bug if still shown.

Title: Completing email registration signs in and lands in the app
Preconditions: Wizard filled: photo, languages + level, terms ticked.
Steps:
1. Tap 'Start Learning!'.
2. Open Profile.
3. Force-kill and relaunch.
Expected: Lands on /home (or Community → Matches when MATCHES_LAYOUT_ENABLED=true). No Terms screen afterwards (terms recorded at signup). Profile shows name, photo, native/learning languages and level. Relaunch goes straight into the app.

Title: New Google user is sent to the mandatory profile wizard
Preconditions: Fresh install (or app data cleared); device online; backend reachable. A Google account never used with BananaTalk, with a profile photo.
Steps:
1. Welcome → 'Continue with Google' → tap 'Sign in with Google'.
2. Pick the Google account in the account picker.
3. Walk the wizard: 'Tell us about yourself' (gender + birth date), Languages, Finish.
Expected: Account picker always appears (previous Google session is signed out first). Then snackbar 'Welcome! Please complete your profile' and the wizard with segments 'About you', 'Languages', 'Finish' – Photo step skipped because Google supplied a photo. Under-18 birth date → 'You must be at least 18 years old'; a typed impossible date → 'Invalid date'.

Title: Completing the Google wizard lands in the app with terms recorded
Preconditions: New Google user on the wizard Finish step.
Steps:
1. Tick terms, tap 'Start Learning!'.
2. Force-kill and relaunch.
Expected: Lands in the app. Relaunch goes straight in – no Terms screen and no wizard (terms accepted via the profile update).

Title: Leaving the mandatory wizard offers Keep going / Sign out
Preconditions: New Google (or Apple) user on the first wizard step.
Steps:
1. Tap the back arrow (also try Android system back and iOS edge-swipe).
2. Tap 'Keep going'.
3. Trigger back again and tap 'Sign out'.
4. Force-kill and relaunch.
Expected: Dialog 'Finish setting up your profile' / 'We need your birthday to keep BananaTalk safe for everyone. You can sign out if you'd rather not continue.' with 'Keep going' and 'Sign out'. Swipe/system back never bypass it. Keep going stays on the step. Sign out lands on the Welcome screen; relaunch stays signed out.

Title: Killing the app mid-wizard brings the wizard back on relaunch
Preconditions: New Google user part-way through the wizard.
Steps:
1. Force-kill the app on the Languages step.
2. Relaunch.
Expected: Splash restores the session and opens the profile wizard again (completion mode) instead of the app. It cannot be skipped; leaving it signs out.

Title: New Apple user (iOS) completes the wizard including the Photo step
Preconditions: iOS device signed into an Apple ID never used with BananaTalk.
Steps:
1. Welcome → 'Continue with Apple' → 'Sign In with Apple'.
2. Choose 'Hide My Email' and continue with Face ID/passcode.
3. Complete About you, Photo, Languages, Finish.
Expected: After Apple sheet: 'Welcome! Please complete your profile'; wizard shows 'About you', 'Photo', 'Languages', 'Finish' (Apple gives no photo, so Photo is required). Completing lands in the app; relay email account is created.

Title: Returning Google / Apple users sign straight in
Preconditions: Completed Google account and (iOS) completed Apple account; both signed out on the device.
Steps:
1. Welcome → 'Continue with Google' → 'Sign in with Google' → pick the account.
2. Log out. On iOS: Welcome → 'Continue with Apple' → 'Sign In with Apple'.
Expected: Each lands on /home with snackbar 'Welcome back, {name}!'. No wizard, no Terms screen. Chat socket connects (real-time messages work).

Title: Cancelling the Google/Apple sheet or going offline shows the right feedback
Preconditions: Fresh install (or app data cleared); device online; backend reachable.
Steps:
1. Open 'Sign in with Google', dismiss the Google account picker.
2. (iOS) Open 'Sign In with Apple', cancel the Apple sheet.
3. Turn on airplane mode, tap 'Sign in with Google' again.
Expected: Cancel: back on the sign-in screen with NO error text. Offline: inline error 'No internet connection' with a 'Try Again' button; 'Back to sign-in methods' returns to Welcome. Raw SDK text (PlatformException, ApiException) is never shown.

Title: Google sign-in with an email that already has a password account links to it
Preconditions: Email/password account A whose address is a Google account (gmail).
Steps:
1. Sign in with Google using that same address.
2. Log out, then log in with email + password for A.
Expected: Google sign-in opens account A (same profile, chats) – no new account, no wizard. Email/password login still works afterwards.

Title: Existing social user with terms not accepted must accept before entering
Preconditions: Completed Google account with termsAccepted=false in the DB (legacy account).
Steps:
1. Sign in with Google.
2. On the Terms of Service screen tap the back arrow.
3. Sign in again, tick the box, 'Accept and Continue'.
Expected: Terms screen appears before the app. Backing out returns to the Google sign-in screen without entering the app. Accepting shows 'Processing...' then lands on /home.

Title: Email login with terms not accepted shows the Terms gate
Preconditions: Email account with termsAccepted=false in the DB.
Steps:
1. Log in with email + password.
2. On 'Terms of Service' tap 'Accept and Continue' without ticking.
3. Tick 'I agree to the Terms of Service and Zero Tolerance Policy', tap 'Accept and Continue'.
Expected: Unticked: snackbar 'Please accept the Terms of Service to continue'. Ticked: button shows 'Processing...', then the app opens with 'Login Successful!'. Server termsAccepted becomes true; next login skips the screen.

Title: Declining Terms on a restored session signs out
Preconditions: Logged-in account whose termsAccepted was set to false server-side after login (and app data has no local accepted flag, e.g. reinstall + login).
Steps:
1. Force-kill and relaunch.
2. On the Terms screen tap the back arrow.
3. Relaunch.
Expected: Splash shows the Terms screen. Back signs the user out and lands on the Welcome screen (no stuck splash). Relaunch stays on Welcome.

Title: Email/password login happy path
Preconditions: Completed email/password account A (profile + terms done). Signed out. Biometric not available or already enabled (so no opt-in dialog).
Steps:
1. Welcome → 'Continue with Email'.
2. Enter email and password, tap 'Login'.
3. Log out; log in again typing the email with uppercase letters and a trailing space.
Expected: Login button shows a spinner (repeat taps ignored), then /home with snackbar 'Login Successful!'. Chats, profile and notifications belong to account A. Mixed-case/trailing-space email logs into the same account.

Title: Client-side validation on the Login screen
Preconditions: Login screen.
Steps:
1. Tap 'Login' with both fields empty.
2. Type 'abc@def' in Email and move focus to Password.
3. Enter a password and tap 'Login'.
4. Tap the eye icon in the password field.
Expected: Empty: 'Please enter both email and password'. On focus-loss the email field shows inline 'Please enter a valid email address'; submitting shows the same as a snackbar; no request sent. Eye icon toggles password visibility. No strength meter on login.

Title: Wrong password, unknown email and unfinished signup errors
Preconditions: Completed email/password account A (profile + terms done).
Steps:
1. Log in with A's email and a wrong password.
2. Log in with an unregistered email.
3. Log in with an email that received a signup code but never finished registration.
Expected: Both show 'Invalid credentials'. Stays on Login, button usable again. Unfinished signup email: 'Please complete your registration first'.

Title: Account locks after 5 wrong passwords
Preconditions: Completed email/password account A (profile + terms done). Two networks available (Wi-Fi and mobile data) – limits are per IP.
Steps:
1. On Wi-Fi enter a wrong password 5 times.
2. Try a 6th time (even the correct password) on the same Wi-Fi.
3. Switch to mobile data and log in with the CORRECT password.
4. After 2 hours (or reset loginAttempts/lockUntil in DB) log in correctly.
Expected: Attempts 1–5: 'Invalid credentials' (the 5th sets a 2-hour lock). 6th from same IP: 'Too many login attempts. Please wait a moment before trying again.' Other network: 'Account is locked. Please try again in 120 minutes.' (minutes count down). After the lock expires login succeeds.
Code ref: lib/providers/provider_root/auth_providers.dart login; backend models/User.js incLoginAttempts; middleware/rateLimiter.js loginLimiter

Title: Social-only account trying email login is told which provider to use
Preconditions: Account created via Google (and one via Apple) – no password set.
Steps:
1. On Login enter the Google account's email and any password.
2. Repeat for the Apple account's email.
Expected: 'This account uses Google sign-in. Please continue with Google.' / 'This account uses Apple sign-in. Please continue with Apple.' No lockout counter, no crash/500.

Title: Remember me pre-fills the email after logout
Preconditions: Completed email/password account A (profile + terms done).
Steps:
1. Log in with 'Remember me' ticked (default), then log out.
2. Open Login: check the email field.
3. Log in with 'Remember me' unticked, log out, open Login again.
Expected: Ticked: email field pre-filled with A's email after logout (and after a relaunch). Unticked: field empty.

Title: Account with incomplete profile is routed through the wizard on login
Preconditions: Email account with profileCompleted=false (e.g. native_language == language_to_learn in DB).
Steps:
1. Log in with email + password.
2. Leave the wizard via back → 'Sign out'.
3. Log in again and complete the wizard.
Expected: Profile wizard opens (only the missing steps). Leaving it signs out and stays on Login (next launch does NOT restore into the wizard). Completing it lands in the app.

Title: No network on auth screens shows a friendly message
Preconditions: Airplane mode ON.
Steps:
1. Login screen: enter valid credentials, tap Login.
2. Register: send a verification code.
3. Forgot Password: tap 'Send Reset Code'.
Expected: Login: 'No internet connection'. Register/Forgot Password: an error snackbar (currently 'Network error. Please check your connection.' – English only). No raw exception text (ClientException, SocketException, URLs). Turning the network back on and retrying works without restarting.

Title: Opt-in dialog after email login enables biometric
Preconditions: Completed email/password account A (profile + terms done). Device with Face ID / fingerprint enrolled; biometric not yet enabled in the app. Test on iPhone (Face ID), Android 13+, and Android 7–8.
Steps:
1. Log in with email + password.
2. On the dialog tap 'Enable'.
3. Pass the OS biometric prompt.
Expected: Dialog: 'Use Face ID to log in next time?' / 'Skip typing your password by signing in with biometrics.' / 'Enable' / 'Later' (title says Face ID even on Android – cosmetic). Enable triggers the OS prompt (Android shows 'Authenticate to log in to Bananatalk'; no PIN/passcode fallback offered). Success → /home with 'Login Successful!'.

Title: 'Later' keeps biometric off and the offer returns next login
Preconditions: Completed email/password account A (profile + terms done). Biometric enrolled on device, not enabled in app.
Steps:
1. Log in, tap 'Later' (or tap outside the dialog).
2. Log out and look at the Login screen.
3. Log in with password again.
Expected: No fingerprint chip on Login after logout. The opt-in dialog appears again on the next password login.

Title: 'Continue as' after logout signs in with live chat
Preconditions: Biometric enabled for account A (previous case). Second device/account to send a message.
Steps:
1. Log out (Profile → menu → Logout).
2. Welcome → 'Continue with Email'.
3. Long-press the fingerprint chip next to Google; then tap it.
4. Pass Face ID / fingerprint. Then cancel the prompt once on a second try to check cancel.
5. From another account send A a message.
6. Force-kill and relaunch while logged out, open Login again.
Expected: Chip visible beside the social icons; long-press tooltip 'Continue as {A's name}'. Success → /home, chat list loads and the incoming message appears live without restarting; push token re-registered (a push arrives when backgrounded). Cancelling the prompt shows nothing and keeps the chip. After relaunch the chip is still there.

Title: Password login of a second account removes 'Continue as'
Preconditions: Biometric enabled for account A; account B exists.
Steps:
1. Log out of A.
2. Log in as B with email + password (tap 'Later' if offered biometric).
3. Log out of B and open Login.
Expected: No fingerprint chip / 'Continue as A' anywhere. A's snapshot is wiped – biometric can never sign into A from B's session. (B is offered biometric for itself.)

Title: Biometric lockouts and denied Face ID show explanations
Preconditions: Biometric enabled for A, logged out, on Login.
Steps:
1. Tap the chip and fail the biometric repeatedly until the OS locks it (Android: 5 wrong fingers).
2. (Android) keep failing after the temporary lock until permanently locked.
3. (iOS) In Settings → BananaTalk turn Face ID OFF, then tap the chip.
Expected: Temporary lock: 'Too many attempts. Biometrics are temporarily locked. Try again later or log in with your password.' Permanent (Android): 'Biometrics are locked. Unlock your device with its passcode, then try again.' Face ID denied: an explanatory error (e.g. "Biometric sign-in isn't available on this device. Please log in with your password.") – never a dead button. Password login still works.

Title: Removing device biometrics hides and disables 'Continue as'
Preconditions: Biometric enabled for A, logged out.
Steps:
1. In device Settings delete all fingerprints / reset Face ID.
2. Open the app → Login.
3. Re-enroll a fingerprint/Face ID, reopen Login.
4. Log in with password.
Expected: Chip hidden after removal and the app's opt-in is turned off; it does NOT come back after re-enrolling. The next password login offers 'Use Face ID to log in next time?' again.

Title: Biometric login offline keeps the option for a retry
Preconditions: Biometric enabled for A, logged out.
Steps:
1. Enable airplane mode.
2. Tap the chip and pass the biometric.
3. Disable airplane mode, tap the chip again.
Expected: Offline: snackbar 'No internet connection'; chip stays. Online retry signs in to /home.

Title: Server-revoked snapshot fails safely
Preconditions: Biometric enabled for A on device 1, logged out. Device 2 available.
Steps:
1. On device 2 reset A's password via Forgot Password.
2. On device 1 tap the chip and pass the biometric.
Expected: Snackbar 'Session expired. Please login again.'; chip disappears (biometric turned off). Login with the new password works and offers biometric again.

Title: Social sign-in does not offer biometric
Preconditions: Completed Google account; device with biometrics enrolled.
Steps:
1. Sign in with Google.
2. Log out and open Login.
Expected: No 'Use Face ID…' dialog after Google/Apple sign-in and no chip on Login (biometric is only offered after email/password login – confirm this is intended).

Title: Reset code is sent and the Verify Code screen opens
Preconditions: Completed email/password account A (profile + terms done).
Steps:
1. Login → 'Forgot Password?'.
2. Enter A's email, tap 'Send Reset Code'.
3. Check the mailbox.
Expected: Screen 'Forgot Password' with 'Reset Password', "Enter your email address and we'll send you a code to reset your password". Snackbar 'Reset code sent to your email!', then 'Verify Code' / 'Enter Reset Code' / 'We sent a 6-digit code to' + email, 'Resend (60s)'. Email code valid 5 minutes. 'Remember your password? Login' returns to Login.

Title: Unknown email and invalid format on Forgot Password
Preconditions: Forgot Password screen.
Steps:
1. Tap 'Send Reset Code' with empty email, then 'abc@def'.
2. Enter an unregistered email.
Expected: 'Please enter your email address', 'Please enter a valid email address', then 'No account found with that email address'.

Title: Valid code → new password → login with the new password
Preconditions: On 'Enter Reset Code' with a fresh code for account A.
Steps:
1. Enter the 6-digit code.
2. On 'Create New Password' enter 'short1A' → Reset Password.
3. Enter 'Newpass12' and confirm 'Newpass13'.
4. Enter 'Newpass12' in both, tap 'Reset Password'.
5. Log in with the old password, then with 'Newpass12'.
Expected: Code accepted: 'Code verified! Create your new password'. Weak: 'Password must be at least 8 characters long'. Mismatch: inline 'Passwords do not match'. Valid: 'Password reset successful! Please login with your new password' and the Welcome/Login screen. Old password → 'Invalid credentials'; new password logs in. Password-changed email received.

Title: Wrong / expired reset codes
Preconditions: On 'Enter Reset Code'.
Steps:
1. Enter a wrong code.
2. Enter wrong codes until 5 attempts.
3. Request a new code, wait more than 5 minutes, enter it.
Expected: Wrong: digits cleared, 'That code is not correct. Check the code and try again.'. 5th: 'Too many incorrect attempts. Request a new code.' with Resend enabled immediately. Expired: 'That code has expired. Request a new one.' and Resend enabled. Resend shows 'Reset code resent!'.

Title: Server-side session end (password reset elsewhere / account removed) redirects once
Preconditions: Account A logged in on device 2 (biometric off).
Steps:
1. On device 1 complete a password reset for A.
2. On device 2 open the app (foreground) and pull to refresh / open a chat.
3. Separately: delete a logged-in account from the admin panel/DB while the app is open, then navigate.
Expected: Device 2 is sent to the Welcome screen with snackbar 'Session expired. Please login again.'; socket disconnected; no crash or retry loop. Deleted account: one redirect to Welcome with 'Session expired. Please login again.' – no repeated snackbars or loop.

Title: Social-only account can set a password via Forgot Password
Preconditions: Google-only account (no password).
Steps:
1. Forgot Password with the Google account's email, complete the reset.
2. Log in with email + new password; then also sign in with Google.
Expected: Reset works; email/password login opens the same account; Google sign-in still works.

Title: Temporary network loss never logs the user out
Preconditions: Completed email/password account A (profile + terms done). Logged in.
Steps:
1. Enable airplane mode for ~1 minute while browsing Chats/Moments.
2. Pull to refresh a few times.
3. Disable airplane mode and keep using the app.
Expected: Offline errors only (no 'Session expired', no redirect to Welcome). Once online, data loads and chat reconnects without logging in again.

Title: Logout from the profile menu
Preconditions: Completed email/password account A (profile + terms done). Logged in.
Steps:
1. Profile tab → open the menu (drawer).
2. Tap 'Logout'; in the dialog tap 'Cancel'.

Title: 'Enable GPS' after a permanent deny opens app settings
Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). Location permanently denied (iOS: denied once; Android: denied twice / 'Don't ask again').

Title: 'Browse by City/Country' after denying location
Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). Location denied.

Title: Radius chips reload the list
Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). Location granted.
Steps: 1. On Nearby tap '5km', then '200km'.
Expected: The selected chip highlights and the list reloads from the top each time: fewer or no users at 5km, more at 200km, all within the chosen distance. No duplicate cards.

Title: Empty radius result still lets the user widen the search
Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). Location granted in an area with no users within 50km (or set a filter that leaves no one).

Expected: Empty state 'No nearby users found' / 'Try expanding your search or check back later.'. Expected: a way to change the radius. Note: the radius chips live inside the list and are hidden in the empty state, and the empty state cannot be pulled to refresh. If you are stuck, log it as a bug.

Title: City map shows country pins with counts and a worldwide preview

Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). Backend MATCHES_LAYOUT_ENABLED=false (prod default).

3. Tap a pin with 0 users.

Title: Topics grid and category chips
Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set).

Title: Received wave appears in the Waves tab
Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). Device B (second account) sends this account a wave with message 'Hi!'.

Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). At least one received wave.

Preconditions: Backend WAVE_CAP_ENABLED=true and appConfig waveCapEnabled on. Non-VIP regular account (15 waves/day; visitor accounts 3/day).

Title: Archive shows waves 7–30 days old
Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). Have waves received 10 days ago and 2 days ago (seed via DB/backdated data if needed).

Refresh keeps the header (no full skeleton flash).

Title: Gatherings empty state
Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). GATHERINGS_ENABLED=true. No upcoming gatherings and no clubs (local backend).

Pick a time and post it — people join gatherings that already have a host.' with a create button and 'Start a club instead'; the clubs area says 'No clubs yet — start one and your gatherings get a home.' The last element clears the floating tab bar.

Title: Create a gathering with validation
Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). GATHERINGS_ENABLED=true.

Errors: 'Give it a name first', 'Pick a time in the future' (and 'Pick a language first' with no language). Seats slider range 2–20; Confirm at never exceeds Seats. Success: 'Posted — now share it' and the gathering appears in the feed marked 'You're hosting'.

Title: Join an open gathering and cancel the RSVP
Preconditions: Two accounts. Device A hosts an upcoming open gathering with free seats. GATHERINGS_ENABLED=true.

2. Check the seats line.
3. Tap 'Cancel my RSVP'.
Expected: After Join: 'You're going', '{going} of {capacity} seats taken' increases by 1, and the quorum line updates. After cancel the button returns to 'Join' and the seat count drops.

Title: Full gathering cannot be joined
Preconditions: Gathering with Seats = 2 hosted by A, already joined by B. Third account C.
Steps: 1. On device C open the gathering.
Expected: Button reads 'Full' and is disabled. A forced join returns 'This gathering is full'.

Preconditions: A gathering with joinMode 'approval' (the app form cannot set this; set it via DB/API). Host A, requesters B and C.

Expected: B sees 'Asked to join — the host will decide'. A sees '{count} waiting to join' with 'Admit' / 'Deny' per person. Admitted B becomes going; C is not seated. A second request from B returns 'Your request is waiting for the host to approve it'.

Title: Host decision two hours before an unconfirmed gathering
Preconditions: Host A's gathering starts within 120 minutes and has fewer 'going' than Confirm at.

Expected: A host box explains the shortfall with buttons 'Run it anyway' and 'Call it off'. The gathering is never auto-cancelled. 'Call it off' cancels it and notifies attendees.

Title: End gathering appears only after the start time

Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). Backend GATHERINGS_ENABLED=false (so the slot after Partners/Gender shows the old Voice rooms tab). Two devices with two accounts. A hosts; B and C joined (3 devices, or 2 + one more account).

Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). Backend GATHERINGS_ENABLED=false (so the slot after Partners/Gender shows the old Voice rooms tab). Two devices with two accounts. A hosts; B joined.

Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). Backend GATHERINGS_ENABLED=false (so the slot after Partners/Gender shows the old Voice rooms tab). Two devices with two accounts. A hosts; B joined.

Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). Backend GATHERINGS_ENABLED=false (so the slot after Partners/Gender shows the old Voice rooms tab). Two devices with two accounts.

Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). Backend ROOMS_ENABLED=true (default). Another user's message is in the room.

Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). Backend MATCHES_LAYOUT_ENABLED=false (prod default). Location granted.

Title: Small screen and dark mode
Preconditions: Logged in with a completed profile (photo, native language and learning language set). 320-pt device (iPhone SE 1st gen / 320dp emulator); repeat in dark mode.
Steps: 1. Visit all Community chips, a match card, a gathering card, the filter sheet and the send-wave sheet.
Expected: No overflow stripes or clipped buttons (the match card's Say hi / Wave / Skip row fits). In dark mode all text, chips and badges are legible.

Title: List loads with skeleton then conversations ordered pinned-first, then newest message
Preconditions: Account A logged in with 5+ conversations; one conversation pinned (older last message); network on
Steps:
1. Cold-start the app and open the Chats tab
2. Watch the list while it loads
3. Compare order with last-message times
Expected: 8 skeleton rows show while loading, then the list. Pinned conversation(s) are at the top regardless of age; the rest are sorted newest last message first. Each row shows avatar, name, preview, time.

Title: Incoming message moves the conversation to the top and bumps the unread badge live
Preconditions: A on Chats tab (list visible); B is an existing partner further down the list
Steps:
1. From B send A a text message
2. Watch A's list without refreshing
3. Have B send two more messages
Expected: B's row jumps to the top (below pinned rows), preview shows the new text, unread badge shows 1 then 3. Bottom-tab Chats badge increases accordingly.

Title: Unread badge caps at 99+ and clears after opening the chat
Preconditions: A has a conversation with B containing 100+ unread messages from B (seed via script or long send loop)
Steps:
1. Open Chats tab
2. Check B's badge
3. Open the chat with B, scroll, go back
Expected: Badge reads "99+". After opening and returning, the badge is gone, the preview is no longer bold, and the bottom-tab Chats count drops by that amount.

Title: Filter chips All / Unread / Online / My turn filter the list
Preconditions: A has: one unread conversation, one partner online now, one conversation where the partner sent last, one where A sent last
Steps:
1. Tap "Unread"
2. Tap "Online"
3. Tap "My turn"
4. Tap "All"
Expected: Unread shows only rows with a badge. Online shows only partners with a live online status. My turn shows only threads whose last message came from the partner (A sent last is excluded). All restores the full list.

Title: Search matches name, @username and last-message text
Preconditions: A has partner B (name "Bora", username bora_k) whose last message contains the word "pizza"
Steps:

2. Type "bor"
3. Clear, type "@bora_k"
4. Clear, type "pizza"
5. Tap the clear (x) button
Expected: Each query shows B's row. Clear restores the full list and empties the field.

Title: Search with no match shows empty state; @username not in chats offers Find @user
Preconditions: A logged in; user C (username charlie_x) exists but A has never chatted with C
Steps:
1. Type "zzzzqq" in search
2. Clear and type "@charlie_x"
3. Tap "Find @charlie_x"
Expected: First: "No results found" / "Try a different search term". Second: "No results found" with body "User @charlie_x not in your chats" and a "Find @charlie_x" button. Tapping it shows "Searching for @charlie_x..." then opens the chat with C.

Title: New chat by username from overflow menu; unknown username shows error
Preconditions: A logged in; user C exists (username charlie_x)
Steps:

2. Choose "New chat by username"
3. Enter "@charlie_x", tap "Find User"
4. Repeat with "@nouser_9999"
Expected: Dialog titled "New Chat" with "Enter username to start a chat". Valid username opens the chat with C (the leading @ is stripped). Unknown username shows an error snackbar "User @nouser_9999 not found".

Title: QR code sheet opens and scanning another user's QR opens their chat
Preconditions: A and B on two devices
Steps:
1. On A: overflow menu > "QR Code"
2. On B: open the same sheet and scan A's QR
3. Back on A, close the sheet
Expected: A's sheet shows A's QR with name/avatar. After B scans, B lands in the chat with A. Closing the sheet on A returns to the list.

Title: Refresh button spins, reloads, ignores double taps and clears the floating tab bar
Preconditions: A on Chats tab with conversations; floating tab bar visible
Steps:
1. Look at the round refresh button bottom-right
2. Tap it, then tap again immediately
3. Scroll the list to the end
Expected: Button sits above the floating tab bar (not covered). First tap shows a spinner in the button and reloads; the second tap while spinning does nothing. Last list row is fully visible above the bar.

Title: Pull-to-refresh reloads the list
Preconditions: A on Chats tab; B sends A a message while A's socket is disconnected (airplane mode on A, then off)
Steps:

2. Pull the list down
Expected: Refresh indicator shows; B's new message and unread badge appear after release.

Title: Swipe a row left reveals Pin / Mute / Delete; pin moves it to top
Preconditions: A has 3+ conversations; B's conversation not pinned
Steps:
1. Swipe B's row left
2. Tap "Pin"
3. Swipe B's row again
Expected: Three actions: Pin, Mute, Delete. After Pin: snackbar "Conversation pinned", B moves to the top with a pin indicator; the action now reads "Unpin". Opening a second row's swipe auto-closes the first.

Title: Swipe Mute / Unmute toggles muted icon and stops pushes
Preconditions: A and B; B's conversation not muted; A's app in background later
Steps:
1. Swipe B's row left, tap "Mute"
2. Background A; from B send a message
3. Return, swipe, tap "Unmute", repeat the send with A backgrounded
Expected: Mute: snackbar "Conversation muted", muted icon on the row, no push on A for B's message. Unmute: "Notifications enabled", icon gone, push arrives.

Title: Swipe Delete asks for confirmation and removes the conversation
Preconditions: A has a conversation with B
Steps:

2. Tap "Cancel"
3. Swipe again, Delete, then confirm "Delete"
Expected: Dialog "Delete Conversation" / "Delete your conversation with B? This cannot be undone.". Cancel keeps the row. Confirm shows "Conversation deleted" and the row disappears; it stays gone after pull-to-refresh.

Title: Empty chat list shows the Chats guide during the guide period; CTA opens Matches
Preconditions: Fresh account A (within 7 days of signup, fewer than 3 activation actions) with no conversations
Steps:

2. Read the card
3. Tap "Find someone"
Expected: Guide card "Your conversations live here" / "Nothing yet. Say hi to one of today's matches and this list fills up." with "Getting started · 0 of 4". The list area shows "Chats" / "Search conversations...". CTA switches to Community > Matches. The card does not flash while the list is loading.

Title: Chats guide retires after the first message is sent
Preconditions: Account A from previous case (guide shown, no chats)
Steps:
1. Open any user's chat and send a text
2. Return to Chats tab
Expected: Guide card gone (list is no longer empty and guide is retired). Analytics: guide_retired (chats, acted), first_message_sent.

Title: Notifications-off banner opens settings and can be dismissed for the session
Preconditions: A with OS notification permission denied for BananaTalk
Steps:
1. Open Chats tab
2. Tap the banner "New Message Alerts"
3. Return, tap the banner's x
Expected: Banner "New Message Alerts" / "Tap to turn on notifications and never miss a message" above search. Tap opens app system settings. x hides it until next app launch.

Title: Draft text shows in the list row
Preconditions: A has a conversation with B
Steps:

2. Go back to the list
3. Re-open B's chat
Expected: B's row preview shows "Draft: half-written note" instead of the last message. Re-opening restores the text into the composer. After sending, the draft label disappears.

Title: Offline load shows one-sentence error and Retry
Preconditions: A logged in; device in airplane mode; app cold-started
Steps:
1. Open Chats tab
2. Disable airplane mode
3. Tap "Retry"
Expected: Wi-Fi-off icon with a readable sentence (e.g. "No internet connection", not a raw exception) and "Retry". After Retry the list loads.

Title: Floating tab bar hides while the Chats search keyboard is open
Preconditions: A on Chats tab
Steps:
1. Tap the search field so the keyboard opens
2. Dismiss the keyboard
Expected: Tab bar hidden while keyboard is up; returns when the keyboard closes, even if the list is now short.

Title: Open conversation from list loads history scrolled to bottom and marks read
Preconditions: A has unread messages from B; B's app open on B's chat with A
Steps:

2. Observe the message list
3. Observe A's messages on B's device
Expected: Spinner then history (latest at bottom). On B, A's own sent messages from before flip to the read state (double tick in accent colour). Unread badge for B cleared on A.

Title: Older messages load on scroll up (pagination)
Preconditions: A and B have 150+ messages
Steps:
1. Open the chat
2. Scroll to the top of the loaded history
Expected: A loading indicator appears at the top and older messages are prepended without the view jumping to the bottom. Date separator chips appear between days.

Title: Empty conversation shows empty state, Tap to say hi sends a wave
Preconditions: A opens chat with C, never messaged before
Steps:

3. Tap "Tap to say hi!"
Expected: "No messages yet" / "Send a message to start the conversation with C". Tapping sends 👋 as a message which appears with sending > sent states.

Title: Opener chips fill the composer but never auto-send
Preconditions: A (native Korean, learning English) opens empty chat with C (native English, learning Korean), sharing at least one topic
Steps:

2. Read the chips under "Conversation starters — tap to edit before sending"
3. Tap one chip
Expected: Up to 3 chips (e.g. reciprocal half-half message, shared topic). Tapping puts the text in the composer with cursor at the end; nothing is sent until A taps send. Chips disappear once a message exists.

Title: Stall rescue banner appears once for a stalled thread
Preconditions: A's chat with B has ≤5 messages and B's message is the newest, older than 24 h
Steps:

2. Tap the suggestion in the banner
3. Leave and re-open the chat
Expected: Banner "B asked you something 👀" with suggestion (shared-topic opener or "Sorry for the slow reply! Still up for chatting? 😊"). Tapping fills the composer. Re-opening: banner not shown again for this conversation.

Title: Send text: optimistic bubble, Sending..., then sent tick
Preconditions: A and B on a stable connection, existing conversation
Steps:

2. Tap the send button
Expected: Composer clears immediately; bubble appears at the bottom with "Sending..." then a single tick. B receives it in real time. Mic icon replaces send when field is empty.

Title: Multi-line, long and emoji-only messages render correctly
Preconditions: A in chat with B
Steps:

2. Send a 2,000-character paragraph
3. Send "😀🎉🇰🇷"
Expected: Composer grows with lines; all three arrive intact on B, wrapped within ~70% of screen width; emojis/flags render, no truncation.

Title: Sending is rate-limited server-side after a burst
Preconditions: A in chat with B (B has replied before)
Steps: 1. Send 15 short messages as fast as possible (within ~3 s)
Expected: First ~10 are sent; the rest should fail visibly ("Failed · Tap for options") rather than hang. Record how long the failing bubbles stay on "Sending..." (server emits messageSendError without ack; app waits for 10 s timeout).

Title: First-chat limit: 5 messages until the other person replies
Preconditions: A has never chatted with C; C never replies
Steps:
1. Send 5 messages to C
2. Send a 6th message
Expected: First 5 send. The 6th fails with a red snackbar showing "You can only send 5 messages until they reply. Please wait for a response." plus "Retry"; the bubble shows "Failed · Tap for options". After C replies, A can send again.

Title: Draft persists across app background/kill
Preconditions: A in chat with B
Steps:
1. Type "draft survives"
2. Background the app, then force-kill it
3. Relaunch, open B's chat
Expected: Composer contains "draft survives".

Title: first_message_sent fires once on a new account's first real message
Preconditions: Fresh account A, Firebase DebugView enabled
Steps:

2. Send one text message in any chat
3. Send a second message
Expected: No event on the Say hi tap alone. Exactly one first_message_sent after the first send; none on the second. activation_milestone (message) also logged.

Title: Notification prime after first message sent/received (live)
Preconditions: Fresh install A, notifications never asked (iOS, or Android 13+); no other pop-up shown this launch
Steps:

Title: Emoji/sticker panel toggles with keyboard and sends a sticker instantly
Preconditions: A in chat with B
Steps:

4. Tap the keyboard icon
Expected: Panel opens and the button turns into a keyboard icon. Tapping a sticker closes the panel and sends it immediately as a sticker message. Keyboard icon brings back the keyboard.

Title: GIF picker search and send
Preconditions: A in chat with B, network on
Steps:

3. Tap a GIF
4. Search "qzxqzxqzx"
Expected: Results grid loads; tapping sends a GIF bubble that animates on both devices. Nonsense query shows "No GIFs found".

Title: Phrases panel: add, insert and delete a saved phrase
Preconditions: A in chat with B, no saved phrases
Steps:

Title: + media panel lists all options; Document under 50MB sends
Preconditions: A in chat with B; a 2MB PDF and a 60MB file on the device
Steps:

4. Repeat with the 60MB file
Expected: PDF uploads with a progress ring and "Sending file..." and arrives as a document bubble. 60MB file shows "Document must be under 50MB.".

Title: Live translate composer sends the translated text
Preconditions: A in chat with B, network on
Steps:

2. Pick "Spanish" in the language picker
3. Type "Good morning, how are you?"
4. Tap send
5. Tap the x on the preview band
Expected: Translate button shows "ES"; preview band shows "Start typing to see the translation" then the live Spanish translation. Sent bubble contains the Spanish text. x closes translate mode.

Title: Floating tab bar hidden and composer stays above keyboard
Preconditions: A in chat with B with 30+ messages
Steps:
1. Tap the composer
2. Type a few lines
3. Dismiss keyboard
Expected: Composer and reply/translation bands sit directly above the keyboard; the latest message stays visible (list anchored to bottom); no tab bar overlaps. On close, layout returns without jump.

Title: Share location after confirmation and permission
Preconditions: A in chat with B; location permission not yet granted
Steps:
1. Tap the Location tool button
2. Read dialog, tap "Share"
3. Grant location permission
4. Repeat on another device and deny the permission
Expected: Dialog "Share your location?" / "Send your current location to B. Only do this with people you trust.". After permission, a location bubble arrives on both devices. Denied: snackbar "Location permission is required to share location", nothing sent.

Title: Record and send a voice message
Preconditions: A in chat with B; mic permission granted
Steps:
1. With the composer empty, tap the mic button
2. Speak for 5 s
3. Tap the send button in the recorder
Expected: Bottom sheet starts recording automatically ("Recording... tap pause or send when done", timer, waveform). Sending closes the sheet and a voice bubble with duration/waveform appears on both devices.

Title: Cancel a recording discards it
Preconditions: A recording a voice message
Steps: 1. Tap the delete (Cancel) button
Expected: Sheet closes, nothing is sent, no bubble appears.

Title: Recording shorter than 1 second is rejected
Preconditions: A in chat with B
Steps: 1. Tap mic and tap send immediately (<1 s)
Expected: Orange snackbar "Recording too short (minimum 1 second)"; nothing sent.

Title: Mic permission first ask and denial
Preconditions: Fresh install; mic permission never asked
Steps:
1. Tap the mic button
2. Deny the OS prompt
3. Tap mic again
Expected: OS prompt appears on first tap. After denial the sheet shows "Microphone permission is required" and closes after ~2 s. On iOS (or Android "don't ask again") later taps show the same error with no settings shortcut - record whether the user has any way forward.

Title: Recording auto-stops and sends at 5 minutes
Preconditions: A in chat with B
Steps: 1. Start recording and leave it running past 5:00
Expected: At 5:00 the recording stops and sends automatically, exactly one voice message.

Title: Play received voice message and transcribe it
Preconditions: B sent A a voice message
Steps:
1. On A tap play on the voice bubble
2. Tap pause, then play again
3. Tap "Transcribe"
Expected: Audio plays through the speaker with progress on the waveform; pause/resume works. "Transcribing…" then the italic transcription under the player; on failure "Couldn't transcribe message".

Title: Send photo from gallery with caption
Preconditions: A in chat with B; photo library has images
Steps:
1. Tap the Gallery tool button
2. Pick a photo
3. Add caption "look!" in the preview, send
Expected: Preview dialog with caption field; upload progress ("Sending photo..."), then image bubble with caption on both devices.

Title: Android 13+ photo picker opens without storage permission prompt
Preconditions: Android 13 or 14 device, fresh install
Steps:
1. Tap the Gallery tool button
2. Pick an image and send
Expected: System Photo Picker opens; no READ_MEDIA_* permission dialog; image sends.

Title: Android 9 gallery pick works with READ_MEDIA_* removed
Preconditions: Android 9 device
Steps:
1. Tap Gallery, pick a photo, send
2. Tap + > Video, pick a video, send
Expected: Picker opens (legacy storage permission prompt if any) and both items send; no crash or silent failure.

Title: Take photo with camera; camera permission first ask
Preconditions: Fresh install, camera permission never asked
Steps:
1. Tap + > Camera
2. Allow camera
3. Take a photo, send from preview
Expected: OS camera prompt then camera UI; photo goes through preview and sends.

Title: Pick video: editor, compression and send
Preconditions: A in chat with B; a 1-minute 1080p video on device
Steps:
1. Tap + > Video, pick the video
2. Trim in the editor, confirm
3. Wait
Expected: Video editor opens (max 10 min). If needed "Compressing video..." dialog, then upload and a video bubble with thumbnail; tapping it plays in the video player on both devices.

Title: Large image over 10MB is rejected client-side
Preconditions: A has a >10MB image file (e.g. via Files as Document is not used; pick via gallery a large PNG)
Steps: 1. Pick the large image from Gallery
Expected: Snackbar "File size exceeds maximum allowed size of 10MB for image files"; nothing uploaded.

Title: Tap image opens full-screen viewer with pinch zoom and rotate
Preconditions: Chat contains an image
Steps:
1. Tap the image bubble
2. Pinch to zoom, pan
3. Tap the rotate icon twice
4. Close and reopen the same image
Expected: Black full-screen viewer titled "1 / 1"; zoom/pan works; each rotate turns 90° clockwise; rotation is remembered on reopen (stored on this device only). There is no save/download button in the chat viewer (expected per current code).

Title: Media, links and docs screen lists shared items
Preconditions: Chat with B contains photos, a link and a document
Steps:
1. Open header menu > "Media, links, and docs"
2. Switch tabs
Expected: Tabs "Media (n)", "Links (n)", "Docs (n)" with correct counts; tapping an item opens it.

Title: Long-press own text message shows menu + reaction bar
Preconditions: A in chat with B; A's own text sent <15 min ago
Steps:
1. Long-press A's message
2. Tap Copy and paste into the composer
Expected: Chat dims; menu shows Reply, Copy, Translate, Save phrase, Pin, Edit, Forward, Delete (no Correct, no Report); reaction bar below the menu. Tap outside closes it. Copy shows snackbar "Copied" and the pasted text matches.

Title: Long-press partner's text message shows Correct and no Delete/Report (1:1)
Preconditions: A in chat with B; B's text message visible
Steps: 1. Long-press B's message
Expected: Menu shows Reply, Copy, Correct, Translate, Save phrase, Pin, Forward. No Edit, no Delete, no Report in 1:1 chat.

Title: Add, change and remove a reaction
Preconditions: A and B in the same chat on two devices
Steps:
1. On A long-press B's message, tap ❤️
2. On A long-press again, tap ❤️ again
3. Tap 👍
Expected: ❤️ appears under the bubble on both devices in real time; tapping the same emoji again removes it; 👍 adds a reaction.

Title: Reply via menu and via swipe; tap quote scrolls to original
Preconditions: Chat with 40+ messages
Steps:
1. Long-press an older B message, tap Reply
2. Check the reply band "Replying to B", send "yes"
3. Swipe another message to the left past the threshold
4. Tap the quoted block in the sent reply
Expected: Reply band above composer with cancel x. Sent bubble shows the quote; B sees the same. Swipe left triggers reply with haptic. Tapping the quote scrolls to and highlights the original.

Title: Sticker or GIF sent while a reply is active keeps its type
Preconditions: A replying to a B message (reply band visible)
Steps:
1. Open the sticker panel and tap a sticker
2. Start another reply and send a GIF
Expected: Each should arrive as a sticker / GIF that quotes the original. Record if they arrive as plain text replies (code sends replies via REST without a type).

Title: Edit own message within 15 minutes
Preconditions: A sent "helo" less than 15 minutes ago
Steps:
1. Long-press it, tap Edit
2. Change to "hello", save
3. Long-press a text message older than 15 minutes
Expected: "Edit Message" dialog; bubble updates to "hello" with an "edited" label on both devices. The older message has no Edit item.

Title: Delete for me removes only on this device
Preconditions: A sent a message to B
Steps:
1. Long-press it, tap Delete
2. Choose "Delete for me"
Expected: Dialog "Delete Message" / "This action cannot be undone.". Message disappears on A only; B still sees it.

Title: Delete for everyone (unsend) within 1 hour
Preconditions: A sent a message to B less than 1 hour ago
Steps: 1. Long-press, Delete, choose "Delete for everyone"
Expected: Option subtitle "Removes for you and B", trailing "Available" (or "Nm left" when <30 min remain). Bubble becomes "This message was deleted" on both devices in real time.

Title: Delete for everyone disabled after 1 hour
Preconditions: A's message older than 1 hour
Steps: 1. Long-press, Delete
Expected: "Delete for everyone" is disabled with "Only available within 1 hour"; "Delete for me" still works.

Title: Pin a message shows pinned bar; unpin removes it
Preconditions: Chat with B
Steps:
1. Long-press a message, tap Pin
2. Scroll away and tap the pinned bar
3. Long-press the same message, tap Unpin
Expected: Snackbar "Message pinned"; "Pinned Message" bar appears at top; tapping it scrolls to the message. Unpin: "Message unpinned", bar disappears.

Title: Forward a message to another partner
Preconditions: A has conversations with B and C (C has no unread messages)
Steps:
1. In B's chat long-press a message, tap Forward
2. Select C, confirm "Forward (1)"
Expected: Dialog "Forward Message" / "Select users to forward to:" lists A's other partners including C. Snackbar "Message forwarded to 1 user(s)"; C receives it. Record if the dialog instead says "No other users to forward to" (the list is built from unread counts only).

Title: Translate a message from the long-press menu
Preconditions: B sent A a Spanish text; A's native language English
Steps: 1. Long-press B's message, tap Translate
Expected: Translation sheet with the English translation (word breakdown/alternatives when present; "Cached" when served from cache).

Title: Quick-action under partner message: inline translate toggles
Preconditions: B sent A a foreign-language text
Steps:
1. Tap the small action chip under B's bubble
2. Tap "Translate"
3. Open the chip again, tap "Hide translation"
Expected: Sheet with Correct / Translate / Save phrase. Translate shows the translation inline under the bubble; Hide translation removes it and it stays collapsed on re-entry.

Title: Daily translation limit for free users (5/day)
Preconditions: Free account A that already used 5 fresh translations today (UTC); coins enabled server-side
Steps:

2. Close; tap the inline Translate chip on another new message
Expected: Translation sheet shows "Daily Translation Limit Reached" / "Free users get 5 translations per day...". Inline path opens "Translation limit reached" sheet with a coin unlock; after unlock the translation appears. Already-translated (cached) messages still translate for free. With coins disabled, record what the inline path shows (code: nothing).

Title: Send a correction and partner accepts it
Preconditions: B sent A "I goed to school"
Steps:
1. On A long-press B's message, tap Correct
2. Edit to "I went to school", add explanation, tap "Send Correction"
3. On B, tap "Accept correction"
Expected: Sheet titled "Correct B's message" with Original / Your correction; Send disabled until text changes. A sees "Correction sent!". B sees a correction bubble "A corrected" with the diff; Accept shows "Correction accepted ✓".

Title: Auto Translate toggle translates incoming messages
Preconditions: A in chat with B (B writes in another language)
Steps:
1. Header menu > "Auto Translate", turn on
2. Have B send a message
Expected: Sheet explains "Incoming messages will be translated automatically"; B's new message shows its translation automatically.

Title: Tip appears once under the first received text message
Preconditions: Fresh account A in guide period (7 days, <3 activation actions); B sends A a text
Steps:
1. Open B's chat on A
2. Have B send a second text
3. Leave the chat without long-pressing and reopen it
Expected: Under B's message: touch icon + "Long-press to translate or correct" with an x. guide_shown (chat_tip) logged once. A second message gets no second tip. Reopening without a long-press: tip still there (showing it does not retire it).

Title: No tip after guide period ends
Preconditions: Account A older than 7 days (or 3 of 4 activation actions done), never acted on the tip
Steps: 1. Receive a text from B, open the chat
Expected: No tip shown.

Title: Long-press or x retires the tip for good
Preconditions: Tip shown in B's chat
Steps:
1. Long-press any message (or tap the tip's x)
2. Close menu, leave and reopen the chat
3. Relaunch the app and reopen
Expected: Tip gone permanently. guide_cta_tapped chat_tip / primary (long-press) or dismiss (x).

Title: Tip can move to a second 1:1 chat in the same run; never in group/room chats
Preconditions: Tip shown in B's chat, not acted on; C also sent A a text; A is a member of a language room
Steps:

2. Open the language room chat
Expected: The tip may appear in C's chat (one tip per app run). The room chat never shows it.

Title: Typing indicator in header
Preconditions: A and B in the same chat
Steps:

2. Stop typing for 5 s
3. Type and send
Expected: A's header subtitle shows animated dots + "typing" while B types, reverts to online status after ~3-5 s idle or after the message arrives.

Title: Delivered and read ticks
Preconditions: A in chat with B
Steps:
1. B fully closes the app (socket offline); A sends a message

Title: iOS (latest): callee foreground, voice call, Wi-Fi
Preconditions: Accounts A (caller, any device) and B (device under test, iOS (latest)) have exchanged >= 5 messages; build 2.7.0 (10580) or newer; mic permission already granted on both. Callee has BananaTalk open on any screen (e.g. Chats tab).
Steps:
1. Leave the callee app in the foreground.

3. On the caller (A) open the chat with B and tap the phone icon in the chat header.
4. On B, observe the ring UI and time to ring; accept.
5. Talk for >= 30 s, both directions.
6. Hang up (alternate the side that hangs up between runs).
7. Open the A-B chat on both phones and the Calls list (Chats tab phone icon).
Expected: Ring UI: the CallKit banner is the only ring UI (iOS reports every VoIP push to CallKit even in the foreground); if the in-app "Incoming Audio Call" screen flashes first it closes and its ringtone stops (IOS-8). (c) Hang-up from either side closes both call screens (repeat the run once ending from the caller, once from the callee). (d) The chat shows exactly ONE call bubble on each side: caller "Outgoing voice call · m:ss", callee "Incoming voice call · m:ss" (same duration). (e) Nothing keeps ringing anywhere afterwards (no native ring UI, no ringtone, no leftover incoming notification).

Steps:
1. Background the callee app, wait >= 5 min. Then, while the call rings, open BananaTalk from the icon.
2. Network: both phones on Wi-Fi.
3. On the caller (A) open the chat with B and tap the phone icon in the chat header.
4. On B, observe the ring UI and time to ring; accept.
5. Talk for >= 30 s, both directions.
6. Hang up (alternate the side that hangs up between runs).
7. Open the A-B chat on both phones and the Calls list (Chats tab phone icon).
Expected: Ring UI: CallKit rings from the VoIP push; after opening the app there is still exactly ONE ring UI (CallKit), no in-app screen and no second ringtone; accepting CallKit joins the call (S-15). (a) The callee starts ringing within 3 s of the caller tapping call. (b) Accept connects both ways: audio both directions, starting on the earpiece; speaker toggle shows "Earpiece". (c) Hang-up from either side closes both call screens (repeat the run once ending from the caller, once from the callee). (d) The chat shows exactly ONE call bubble on each side: caller "Outgoing voice call · m:ss", callee "Incoming voice call · m:ss" (same duration). (e) Nothing keeps ringing anywhere afterwards (no native ring UI, no ringtone, no leftover incoming notification).

Preconditions: Accounts A and B have exchanged >= 5 messages; new build (2.7.0+) on both unless stated; mic/camera granted. Callee accepted from the lock screen / native call UI.
Steps:

3. Reopen within ~15 s.

5. Repeat killing the caller instead, and a callee that accepted in-app.

Caller side and in-app accepts never rejoin (by design): the peer sees the call end after ~20 s. Answering from the lock screen while killed still connects (S-14). iOS may end the CallKit call itself when the process dies; if so iOS cannot rejoin - record which.
