Steps:
1. Open VIP Status.
2. Read the text under the button.
3. Tap 'Manage Subscription'.
Expected: Caption 'To cancel your subscription, go to Settings > [Your Name] > Subscriptions on your device.' is shown. Tap opens apps.apple.com/account/subscriptions.

Title: VIP Status shows subscription details
Preconditions: Active VIP with subscription record
Steps: 1. Open VIP Status.
Expected: 'VIP Member' header and Subscription Details: Status ACTIVE, Plan, Start Date, End Date, Next Billing Date (if any), Auto Renew Yes/No (green/orange).

Title: Cancelled subscription shows Auto Renew = No but stays VIP until end date
Preconditions: Active sandbox VIP
Steps:
1. Cancel the subscription in the store.
2. Wait a few minutes for the store notification.
3. Reopen VIP Status.
Expected: Auto Renew shows 'No' (orange); user keeps VIP benefits until End Date.

Title: Expired subscription shows 'VIP Expired' and ads return
Preconditions: Sandbox VIP that has expired (sandbox monthly = 5 min) and was cancelled
Steps:
1. Wait for expiry.
2. Relaunch the app.
3. Open the Profile VIP card; open Chats.
Expected: VIP Status shows 'VIP Expired' with 'Expired on: <date>' and a 'Manage in App Store' (iOS) / 'Manage Subscription' (Android) button. Banner ads reappear in the Chats list; limits revert to regular.

Title: Non-VIP opening VIP Status sees empty state
Preconditions: Logged in as a non-VIP account; release or TestFlight/internal-track build (reach VIP Status via an old deep path, e.g. right after expiry)
Steps: 1. Open VIP Status as a non-VIP with userMode regular.
Expected: 'No active VIP subscription' with a 'Become VIP' button. Note: the button only pops the screen; it does not open the plans screen (record if confusing).

Title: Ads disappear immediately after purchase
Preconditions: Non-VIP with banner visible in Chats list
Steps:
1. Note the banner in the Chats list.
2. Buy VIP.
3. Return to Chats.
Expected: Chats list banner and 'Remove ads' button gone; no interstitials or native ads in Moments/Learn afterwards.

Title: Daily moment limit lifted for VIP
Preconditions: Regular account that already created 5 moments today (regular momentsPerDay=5)
Steps:
1. Try to post a 6th moment as regular — note the 'Daily Limit Reached' dialog.
2. Buy VIP.
3. Post the moment again.
Expected: As regular: dialog 'Daily Limit Reached'. As VIP: moment posts without any limit dialog.

Title: Translations unlimited for VIP
Preconditions: Regular account that used 5 translations today
Steps:
1. Translate a 6th message (limit sheet appears).
2. Upgrade to VIP.
3. Translate again.
Expected: Regular: translate-limit sheet with unlock options. VIP: translation succeeds, no sheet.

Title: Profile visitors revealed for VIP
Preconditions: Regular account with recent profile visitors; then VIP
Steps:
1. As regular open Profile > visitors.
2. Note masked rows.
3. As VIP reopen visitors.
Expected: Regular: masked tile 'N people viewed your profile' / 'See who for {cost} coins, or go VIP'. VIP: visitor names/avatars visible, no masked tile, no banner ad.

Title: VIP badge appears on profile
Preconditions: Account just upgraded
Steps: 1. Open own profile; have another account open it.
Expected: VIP badge / avatar frame visible to self and others.

Title: Coin shop opens from the balance pill and shows packs
Preconditions: Logged in as a non-VIP account; release or TestFlight/internal-track build; backend COINS_ENABLED=true
Steps:
1. Tap the blue '💎 <balance>' pill in the Chats app bar.
2. Inspect the screen.
Expected: 'Coin Shop' with 'Get Coins' header, 'Your balance' row, 'Earn free coins' (Daily reward, Watch an ad) and three packs: 100 coins, 500 coins '+25 bonus included', 1500 coins '+250 bonus included' ('BEST VALUE'), each with a store price button. Explainer about non-refundable coins at the bottom.

Title: Coin pill and shop hidden when coins are disabled
Preconditions: Backend COINS_ENABLED=false (local backend)
Steps:
1. Cold start.
2. Look at Chats, Community, Profile and AI Study app bars.
Expected: No '💎' pill anywhere; unlock-for-coins buttons absent in limit dialogs.

Title: Buy the 100-coin pack (sandbox)
Preconditions: Logged in as a non-VIP account; release or TestFlight/internal-track build; sandbox/licence tester; note current balance
Steps:
1. Open Coin Shop.
2. Tap the price on the 100-coin pack.
3. Confirm in the store sheet.
Expected: Pack button shows a spinner; snackbar 'Coins added! 💎'; balance increases by exactly 100 in the shop and app-bar pill; Coin History shows a purchase row.

Title: Bonus coins credited for the 500 and 1500 packs
Preconditions: Sandbox account
Steps:
1. Buy the 500 pack.
2. Buy the 1500 pack.
Expected: Balance increases by 525 and 1750 respectively (server PACKS).

Title: Consumable can be bought again
Preconditions: Already bought the 100 pack once
Steps: 1. Buy the 100 pack a second time.
Expected: Store allows a second purchase (no 'You already own this item'); +100 again. Confirms the consumable was finished after verify.

Title: Cancel the coin store sheet
Preconditions: Sandbox account
Steps:
1. Tap a pack price.
2. Cancel the store sheet.
Expected: Snackbar 'Purchase was canceled or could not be started.'; balance unchanged; buttons re-enabled.

Title: Only one pack purchase can run at a time
Preconditions: Sandbox account
Steps: 1. Tap the 100 pack price, and while the sheet opens tap the 500 pack price.
Expected: Only one store sheet; the other pack buttons are disabled while one is busy.

Title: Verification failure leaves the purchase retryable
Preconditions: Sandbox account; backend unreachable after store success (airplane mode right after confirming)
Steps:
1. Buy a coin pack, toggle airplane mode on immediately after confirming.
2. Read the message.
3. Turn network back on, relaunch, reopen Coin Shop.
Expected: Message shown (no crash). Expected per copy 'It will be retried automatically — try restoring purchases…'. SUSPECTED BUG: no global purchase listener re-verifies redelivered transactions and there is no Restore button, so coins may never arrive; also a thrown network exception has no catch and may show nothing. Record balance after relaunch.

Title: Replayed receipt is not double-credited
Preconditions: Sandbox; ability to resend the same verify request (proxy) or redelivered store transaction
Steps:
1. Buy a pack.
2. Replay the same /coins/verify-purchase body (same transactionId).
Expected: Server answers 200 with credited 0, alreadyCredited true; balance does not increase a second time. Note the app would still show 'Coins added! 💎' for the replay.

Title: Balance pill updates after spend and earn
Preconditions: Account with ≥80 coins
Steps:
1. Note pill balance.
2. Spend coins on an unlock.
3. Claim daily reward.
Expected: Pill updates without restart after each action; tap on 'Your balance' row opens 'Coin History' listing each transaction.

Title: Daily reward claim once per UTC day
Preconditions: Account that has not claimed today
Steps:
1. Open Coin Shop.
2. Tap 'Claim' on Daily reward.
3. Tap again / reopen the shop.
Expected: Snackbar 'Daily reward claimed! +10 💎'; balance +10; card shows 'Come back tomorrow' and a disabled 'Claimed' button. Reopening keeps it claimed.

Title: Watch-ad reward credits 5 coins
Preconditions: Logged in as a non-VIP account; release or TestFlight/internal-track build; rewarded ad loaded
Steps:
1. Open Coin Shop.
2. Tap 'Watch ad (+5 💎)'.
3. Watch the ad to the end and close it.
Expected: Button shows 'Crediting…', then snackbar 'Thanks for watching! +5 💎' and balance +5.

Title: Ad reward daily cap of 5
Preconditions: Logged in as a non-VIP account; release or TestFlight/internal-track build
Steps:
1. Watch and complete 5 rewarded ads from Coin Shop.
2. Watch a 6th.
Expected: After the 6th: snackbar "You've reached today's ad reward limit — come back tomorrow!" (hardcoded English — check in a non-English locale), card text 'Daily limit reached — come back tomorrow', button 'Limit reached' disabled.

Title: Watch-ad button becomes enabled when the ad finishes loading
Preconditions: Logged in as a non-VIP account; release or TestFlight/internal-track build; cold start, open Coin Shop within 1-2 s
Steps:
1. Cold start the app and open Coin Shop immediately.
2. Wait 10 s without touching the screen.
Expected: Button should become tappable once the rewarded ad has loaded. SUSPECTED BUG: RewardedAdButton reads isRewardedAdReady once per build and nothing rebuilds on ad load, so it may stay greyed until you leave and reopen.

Title: VIP user in Coin Shop: watch-ad card
Preconditions: Active VIP
Steps: 1. Open Coin Shop.
Expected: Record layout: RewardedAdButton renders nothing for VIP, so the Watch an ad card has an empty action area. Should be hidden or explained.

Title: Unlock extra translations with coins
Preconditions: Regular account at 5/5 translations, ≥50 coins, COINS_ENABLED
Steps:
1. Try to translate a message.
2. In the limit sheet tap 'Unlock 10 for 💎50'.
Expected: Single tap (no confirmation) spends 50 coins; snackbar 'Unlocked +10 more! 💎'; translation then works; balance -50.

Title: Insufficient coins for an unlock
Preconditions: Account with fewer coins than the unlock cost
Steps: 1. Hit a limit and tap the unlock-for-coins button.
Expected: Snackbar 'Not enough coins for that.' with action 'Get more coins' that opens Coin Shop; balance unchanged.

Title: Extra matches max reached
Preconditions: MATCHES/DAILY_MATCHES enabled; already unlocked 9 extra matches today
Steps: 1. On Matches, tap the extra-matches unlock again.
Expected: Snackbar 'You already have the maximum extra matches for today'; the unlock button disappears; coins refunded/unchanged.

Title: Message limit dialog offers coin unlock, ad and VIP
Preconditions: Regular account at its daily message cap (if messages capped) or moment cap
Steps:
1. Trigger the limit (e.g. 6th moment).
2. Read the dialog actions.
Expected: 'Daily Limit Reached' with usage meter, 'Limit Resets At <date>', 'VIP Members Get' list, buttons 'Maybe Later', unlock-for-coins (if coins on), 'Watch Ad' (if an ad is loaded) and 'Upgrade to VIP' (opens plans).

Title: Buy a profile boost with coins
Preconditions: BOOSTS_ENABLED=true; ≥150 coins
Steps:
1. Profile drawer > 'Boost my profile'.
2. Tap 'Confirm boost'.
Expected: Card shows 'Cost: 150 coins' and 'Your balance: N coins'. After confirm: 'Your boost is live', '<h>h <m>m left', 'Seen by N people so far'; balance -150.

Title: Boost with too few coins opens the shop
Preconditions: BOOSTS_ENABLED=true; <150 coins
Steps:
1. Open Boost my profile.
2. Tap 'Confirm boost'.
Expected: Coin Shop opens (402 insufficient coins); no boost started.

Title: Boost capacity full message
Preconditions: BOOSTS_ENABLED=true; server at boost capacity
Steps: 1. Confirm a boost.
Expected: Message 'All boost slots are taken right now — try again in a few hours'; coins not spent.

Title: Invite friends screen shows code, copy and share
Preconditions: REFERRALS_ENABLED=true on backend
Steps:
1. Profile drawer > 'Invite friends'.
2. Tap 'Copy', then 'Share'.
Expected: Shows 'Your invite code', 'Invited: N', explanation text. Copy shows 'Copied' and clipboard holds https://banatalk.com/i/<CODE>. Share sheet text: 'Join me on BananaTalk — practice languages with real people. Use my invite code <CODE>: <link>'.

Title: Invite row hidden when referrals are off
Preconditions: REFERRALS_ENABLED=false (prod default)
Steps: 1. Open the Profile drawer.
Expected: No 'Invite friends' row.

Title: New user installs via /i/ link and gets the referral reward
Preconditions: REFERRALS_ENABLED=true; inviter code from account A; App Links verified (or use bananatalk://i/<CODE>); app installed but logged out
Steps:
1. Tap https://banatalk.com/i/<CODE> on the device.
2. App opens to splash/login; sign up a new account and complete the profile form.
3. Watch for a snackbar on landing.
Expected: Snackbar 'You earned 50 coins!' after signup; invitee balance +50; inviter A balance +100 and 'Invited' +1.

Title: Referral rejected for an existing account or own code
Preconditions: REFERRALS_ENABLED=true
Steps:
1. Logged-in old account opens /i/<own or other CODE>.
2. Complete any flow.
Expected: No coins credited and no error toast for a silent claim; own code is rejected ('You cannot refer yourself') and pending code is cleared.

Title: Invalid invite code format is ignored
Preconditions: Any
Steps: 1. Open bananatalk://i/abc! (or https://banatalk.com/i/xx).
Expected: Link does not route to /invite (code must be 4-16 chars A-Z2-7); app just opens normally.

Title: Banner + 'Remove ads' in the Chats list for non-VIP
Preconditions: Logged in as a non-VIP account; release or TestFlight/internal-track build; BOOSTS_ENABLED=true for the Remove ads button
Steps:
1. Open the Chats tab.
2. Look at the compact banner and the 'Remove ads' text button.
3. Tap 'Remove ads'.
Expected: 50 px banner loads; 'Remove ads' opens the VIP plans screen. With BOOSTS_ENABLED=false the button is hidden while the banner still shows.

Title: Banner failing to load leaves no broken space
Preconditions: Logged in as a non-VIP account; release or TestFlight/internal-track build; ad blocked network (e.g. DNS ad blocker) or no fill
Steps: 1. Open Profile followers list, Learn tab and Chats list.
Expected: SmallBanner collapses to nothing. Note: BannerAdWidget reserves an empty 60 px box when not loaded — record if a permanent blank gap shows.

Title: Interstitial at most every 3rd moment open and ≥90 s apart
Preconditions: Logged in as a non-VIP account; release or TestFlight/internal-track build; REWARDED_LIMITS_ENABLED=false
Steps:
1. Open and close 3 moments from the feed quickly.
2. Open and close 3 more within 90 s.
3. Wait 90 s and open/close 3 more.
Expected: First interstitial after the 3rd return; none in the next batch inside 90 s; another after the gap. Never for VIP.

Title: Once-per-session interstitial when rewarded limits flag is on
Preconditions: Logged in as a non-VIP account; release or TestFlight/internal-track build; REWARDED_LIMITS_ENABLED=true
Steps:
1. Open a chat with ≥10 messages and leave it.
2. Exhaust today's matches.
3. Open several moments.
Expected: At most one interstitial in the whole app session across chat_leave, matches_exhausted and moment triggers. Note lesson completion / story setup / lesson builder call showInterstitial directly and may bypass the cap — record.

Title: Watch Ad in the limit dialog unlocks and closes the dialog
Preconditions: Logged in as a non-VIP account; release or TestFlight/internal-track build; REWARDED_LIMITS_ENABLED=true; feature in rewardedFeatures
Steps:
1. Hit the moment limit.
2. Tap 'Watch Ad' and watch to the end.
Expected: Snackbar 'Unlocked! You can try again now.'; dialog closes with result unlocked; retry succeeds.

Title: Rewarded unlock daily cap message
Preconditions: Logged in as a non-VIP account; release or TestFlight/internal-track build; REWARDED_LIMITS_ENABLED=true
Steps:
1. Use the 'Watch Ad' unlock for the same feature 5 times.
2. Try a 6th.
Expected: Snackbar "You've used today's free unlocks for this — try again tomorrow"; no unlock.

Title: Closing the rewarded ad early grants nothing
Preconditions: Logged in as a non-VIP account; release or TestFlight/internal-track build
Steps:
1. From Coin Shop start a rewarded ad.
2. Close it before the reward is earned.
Expected: No credit snackbar; balance unchanged; a new ad loads for the next attempt.

Title: Ads notice waits for the guide period and shows once
Preconditions: Account older than 7 days (or 3 of 4 activation actions done); fresh install; no update/announcement due
Steps:
1. Cold start.
2. Read the bottom sheet.
3. Tap 'Got it, thanks! 👍'.
4. Relaunch.
Expected: Sheet 'A note from the developer' with the solo-developer body and 4 perks; shown once per install, never again after relaunch or logout. Not shown inside a new account's guide period.

Title: No GDPR/UMP consent form or ATT prompt is shown
Preconditions: EU-region device (or VPN) and iOS 14.5+
Steps: 1. Fresh install, sign in, browse ad surfaces.
Expected: Record observed behaviour: the app has no UMP ConsentInformation or ATT request; only the ads notice sheet. Flag for policy review if EU traffic matters.

Title: iOS first launch grants provisional (quiet) permission without a dialog
Preconditions: iOS fresh install (never asked)
Steps:
1. Install and launch the app.
2. Watch for any system notification dialog on splash.
3. Open iOS Settings > Notifications > BananaTalk.
Expected: No system dialog at launch. Settings shows 'Deliver Quietly' (provisional). A push from B lands silently in Notification Center.

Title: Android 13+ fresh install: no OS dialog at splash
Preconditions: Android 13+ fresh install (or app data cleared)
Steps:
1. Install and launch.
2. Watch splash and login.
Expected: No POST_NOTIFICATIONS dialog appears on splash/login; it is only raised from the priming sheet.

Title: Android 13+: 'Turn on' in the prime raises the real system dialog
Preconditions: Android 13+ fresh install; new account reaches a priming trigger (e.g. first matches)
Steps:
1. Reach the prime sheet.
2. Tap 'Turn on'.
3. Allow in the system dialog.
Expected: System 'Allow BananaTalk to send you notifications?' dialog appears. After Allow, Settings > Apps > BananaTalk > Notifications is on. Analytics `notification_prime_result` = granted.

Title: Android 13+: grant from the prime delivers notifications in the same session
Preconditions: Android 13+ fresh install, granted from the prime (previous case); app still running
Steps:
1. Without relaunching, background the app.
2. From B send A a chat message.
3. Bring A to foreground and have B send a moment like.
Expected: Background chat push shows as a heads-up banner immediately (no relaunch needed). Foreground non-chat push (moment like) shows a local banner. Note: foreground chat_message pushes are deliberately suppressed by the app (socket delivers them), so test chat with the app backgrounded.

Title: Android: after 'Not now' or deny, next launch shows the notifications-off card instead of the prime
Preconditions: Android 13+; chose 'Not now' in the prime (or denied the OS dialog)
Steps:
1. Relaunch.
2. Repeat a prime trigger (first wave, open Community).
3. Open Profile drawer > Notifications (preferences screen).
Expected: Prime is never shown again on this install. Preferences screen shows card 'Notifications are off' with 'Open settings', which opens the app's system notification settings.

Title: Android 12 and below: notifications already allowed, no prime
Preconditions: Android 8-12 device, fresh install
Steps: 1. Install, sign up, reach every prime trigger.
Expected: No priming sheet; pushes arrive normally.

Title: Enabling notifications later from system settings
Preconditions: Android 13+ with notifications denied
Steps:
1. Open system settings via the notifications-off card and enable notifications.
2. Return to the app; have B send a chat while A is backgrounded.
3. If nothing arrives, relaunch and retry.
Expected: Record whether pushes arrive in the same session. Delivery set-up only runs at launch or after the prime, so a relaunch may be needed (expected after relaunch at the latest).

Title: First matches shown on the Community tab triggers the prime once
Preconditions: New account; MATCHES_LAYOUT_ENABLED=true (local backend); iOS or fresh Android 13+
Steps: 1. Select the Community tab and let the first matches load.
Expected: Prime sheet 'Get notified when someone replies' with 'Turn on' / 'Not now'; `notification_prime_shown` (first_matches). Shown only once.

Title: Waves tab first showing received waves triggers the prime
Preconditions: New account with at least one received wave; prime not yet shown
Steps: 1. Open Community > Waves.
Expected: Prime shown if not already shown; `notification_prime_shown` (first_wave).

Title: First live message sent or received in an open chat triggers the prime
Preconditions: New account; prime not yet shown; chat with B open
Steps: 1. Send the first message (or have B send one live while the chat is open).
Expected: Prime appears if not already shown. A message that arrived as a push before opening the chat does not count.

Title: Opening a chat does not trigger priming
Preconditions: New account; prime not yet shown
Steps: 1. Open any existing chat without sending or receiving.
Expected: No prime sheet.

Title: Prime is deferred when another pop-up already showed this launch
Preconditions: Account where a launch pop-up (e.g. update dialog) already showed this launch
Steps:
1. Dismiss the launch pop-up.
2. Trigger a prime (first matches).
Expected: No prime this launch (one pop-up budget per launch); it can appear on a later launch.

Title: Prime result: Turn on / Not now / swipe away
Preconditions: Three fresh installs (or reset app data between runs)
Steps:
1. Run 1: tap 'Turn on' then Allow (or Don't Allow).
2. Run 2: tap 'Not now'.
3. Run 3: swipe the sheet down.
Expected: Run 1: OS dialog; `notification_prime_result` granted / declined. Runs 2-3: no OS dialog, result `later`, never offered again on this install (survives logout).

Title: Fully granted permission: no prime; iOS provisional still primed
Preconditions: Device A: notifications fully allowed. Device B: iOS with provisional only
Steps: 1. Reach a prime trigger on both.
Expected: A: no prime. B (iOS provisional): prime shown; 'Turn on' upgrades to full alerts (banner + sound).

Title: Prime is not shown during an active call
Preconditions: Fresh install, prime pending; in a call with B
Steps: 1. During the call, trigger a prime condition (e.g. receive a live message).
Expected: No prime sheet over the call.

Title: Background chat push on Android: heads-up banner with white bubble icon
Preconditions: Two accounts A (receiver, test device) and B (sender, second device); notifications allowed on A; Android; app in background
Steps:
1. Press Home on A.
2. From B send A a text message.
3. Pull down the shade on A.
Expected: Heads-up banner with title = sender name, body = message; small icon is the white chat bubble (not a grey square); sound + vibration.

Title: Android channel is 'High Importance Notifications'
Preconditions: Android; app launched once with notifications allowed
Steps: 1. Open system Settings > Apps > BananaTalk > Notifications.
Expected: Categories include 'High Importance Notifications' (description 'Chat messages and urgent notifications') and 'Incoming Calls'.

Title: Killed-state push displays
Preconditions: Two accounts A (receiver, test device) and B (sender, second device); notifications allowed on A; force-stop / swipe away A
Steps:
1. Kill the app on A.
2. From B send a chat and a wave.
Expected: Both appear as system notifications on A (lock screen and shade).

Title: Foreground: chat push is not shown as a banner (socket handles it)
Preconditions: Two accounts A (receiver, test device) and B (sender, second device); notifications allowed on A; A on the Moments tab (not in that chat)
Steps:
1. Keep A foregrounded on Moments.
2. From B send a chat message.
Expected: No system banner; Chats tab badge increments and the message appears in the list in real time.

Title: Foreground: non-chat push shows a local banner with the sender avatar
Preconditions: Two accounts A (receiver, test device) and B (sender, second device); notifications allowed on A; A foregrounded
Steps:
1. From B like A's moment.
2. From B follow A.
Expected: Local banner shown for each, with B's profile picture as large icon (Android) / attachment (iOS).

Title: Foreground banners suppressed in quiet hours except calls
Preconditions: A with Quiet Hours enabled covering the current local time
Steps:
1. Keep A foregrounded.
2. From B like A's moment.
3. From B call A and hang up (missed call).
Expected: No banner for the like; missed-call notification still shows.

Title: Quiet hours in a non-Seoul timezone hold pushes at local night
Preconditions: Phone timezone e.g. Europe/Berlin; Quiet Hours 22:00-08:00 saved
Steps:
1. Check server quietHours.timezone equals the phone zone.
2. Inside the window (local), have B like a moment.
3. Open the notifications list.
Expected: No push during local quiet hours; list row shows the 'Silenced by Quiet Hours' icon/tooltip.

Title: Daily cap silences excess notifications
Preconditions: A receives >5 moment likes in a day (cap moment_like: 5)
Steps:

2. Open notifications list.
Expected: Only 5 pushes; later rows show a silenced icon with tooltip 'Silenced by daily limit'.

Title: Missed call notification with Call back / Message
Preconditions: A and B can call; A backgrounded
Steps:

2. Expand the missed-call notification on A.
3. Tap 'Message'.
Expected: Notification shows missed call with 'Call back' and 'Message' actions; Message opens the chat with B; missed-calls badge refreshed.

Title: Chat push tap (background) opens the chat
Preconditions: Two accounts A (receiver, test device) and B (sender, second device); notifications allowed on A; A backgrounded
Steps:
1. B sends a message.
2. Tap the notification on A.
Expected: App opens Home then pushes /chat/<B>; back returns to the tab shell.

Title: Chat push tap from killed state opens the chat
Preconditions: Two accounts A (receiver, test device) and B (sender, second device); notifications allowed on A; A killed
Steps:
1. B sends a message.
2. Tap the notification.
Expected: Splash then the chat with B opens (~1 s after start); no launch pop-up this process.

Title: Wave push opens the chat with the waver
Preconditions: Two accounts A (receiver, test device) and B (sender, second device); notifications allowed on A
Steps:

Expected: Opens /chat/<B>.

Title: New follower push opens the follower's profile
Preconditions: Two accounts A (receiver, test device) and B (sender, second device); notifications allowed on A

Title: Moment like / comment push opens the moment

Title: Profile visit push opens the visitor profile

Expected: Opens /profile/<B>.

Title: Study reminder pushes open AI Study

Steps:

Title: Daily drop push opens the daily pack
Preconditions: Daily drop delivery on (DAILY_DROP_DELIVERY_ENABLED not false)
Steps:

Expected: Opens /learning/daily (Study Hub daily pack).

Title: Announcement push opens the announcement screen
Preconditions: Live announcement with notify on
Steps: 1. Tap the announcement push.
Expected: Opens /announcement/<id> with title 'Announcement', body in the app language, optional image/emoji and button.

Title: Lifecycle daily_matches push lands on Community > Matches
Preconditions: DAILY_MATCHES / lifecycle push enabled

Expected: App shows the Community tab with the Matches (resp. Waves) sub-tab selected; tab bar visible.

Title: VIP renewal warning push opens home
Preconditions: Account with vip_renewal_warning push
Steps: 1. Tap the push.
Expected: App opens on the home shell (no dedicated screen).

Title: Unknown type with no route falls back to home, never 'page not found'
Preconditions: Ability to send a test push with type 'xyz' and route '/voicerooms/123'
Steps: 1. Send the test push; tap it.
Expected: Opens the closest known screen or home; never go_router's 'Page Not Found'.

Title: iOS chat push 'Reply' action sends a quick reply
Preconditions: iOS; A backgrounded; chat push from B
Steps:

Expected: Message 'hi' appears in the chat on B; A is not navigated away. Record if the action is missing or does nothing.

Title: Bell badge and list open
Preconditions: A with 3 unread notifications
Steps:
1. Look at the bell in the Chats app bar.
